title: Limitations of use.
officialText:
Reinforced gypsum concrete shall not be used where exposed directly to the weather or where subject
to frequent or continuous wetting. Precast units shall be protected by coverings or coatings from the weather and from contact
with moisture during shipment and during storage at the work site.
SECTION BC 1915
CONCRETE-FILLED STEEL COLUMNS
